about: The reviewed corrections table (P1.16, amended by P1.21): the only changes the build makes to the source text beyond mechanical cleaning. Every entry is an error a P1.1 verification agent confirmed against the official page image. Each names the case, the printed page, and the verification batch that found it. Entry types: find/replace (a find must occur exactly once in the case); insert_after (printed lines Lawbox omits); kind_from/kind_to (paragraph kind over a range); set_note (an opinion's joined_by_note); page_starts_at (unique text where a printed page begins); remove_break (a spurious page break in the paragraph or footnote holding the text); split_at (where print starts a new paragraph). A word divided across a page turn is on the page where it begins. One entry (source main_T1.5, Oliver's Part II heading) was confirmed against the page image by the main session instead, as T1.5 directs.
